items.title: The Pensions Regulator publishes artificial intelligence guidance for schemes
items.summary: The Pensions Regulator has released a new framework outlining seven principles for trustees and scheme managers on deploying artificial intelligence.

items.title: Chancellor Healey announces £65bn in additional borrowing in autumn fiscal statement
items.summary: Chancellor Healey has set out £65bn of extra borrowing over five years in a targeted fiscal statement designed to avoid market disruption.

items.title: FCA warns consumers over unauthorised firm www.hedgemarksecuritiesllc.com
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has issued a warning against www.hedgemarksecuritiesllc.com for providing financial services without authorisation.

items.title: European Central Bank holds interest rates steady at 2.5%
items.summary: The European Central Bank has kept its three key interest rates unchanged following a similar decision by the US Federal Reserve.

items.title: Chancellor raises machine games duty on slot machines to 25% in budget
items.summary: Chancellor John Healey has increased machine games duty from 20% to 25% in his budget, targeting adult gaming centres and bookmakers.

items.title: BlackRock launches European investment grade and high yield active ETFs
items.summary: BlackRock has introduced two actively managed fixed income UCITS exchange-traded funds targeting European investment grade and high yield credit.
